claims.statement: For nonzero real functions q_j on disjoint blocks, Phi(product q_j)/product p_j=sum_j Phi(q_j)/p_j and I(product q_j)/product p_j=sum_j I(q_j)/p_j, where Phi(q)=Eraw(q)-||q||_2^2 log2(1/||q||_2^2).
claims.scope: All finite dimensions and finite disjoint products; exact normalized-spectral identity with no depth or arity loss.

claims.statement: The universal indicator estimate Eraw(q)<=2I(q)+p log2(1/p) fails already for the two-bit NAND indicator by 1-(3/8)log2(3)>0.
claims.scope: Exact Boolean indicator witness; sign certified by 3^3<2^8.

claims.statement: The five-bit indicator with mask 4146264055 and all its tensor powers satisfy Phi/I=K*=3.921809106893846..., forcing K>=K*>3.921 in every universal bound Phi(q)<=K I(q).
claims.scope: Exact seed, every positive tensor power, dimension 5k; certified lower bound by an exact integer comparison.

claims.statement: For f_k=2s^{tensor k}-1, H(f_k)/I(f_k) converges to 4.874685194779820..., so the family is a bounded genuine-Boolean control rather than an FEI counterfamily.
claims.scope: All k>=1 with an exact closed formula and asymptotic limit.

claims.statement: The complete sign ensemble is paid, but the actual physical signing still lacks a uniform activation witness. The unsigned coefficient-two indicator projection is now refuted and must be replaced by a signed near/separated or terminal-reserve mechanism.
